parsed.name: 化学气相沉积控制器
parsed.description: 用于化学气相沉积（CVD）工艺的控制设备，可设置气体流量和温度等工艺参数，保存/载入配方，并启动或停止工艺运行。
parsed.description_en: A control unit for chemical vapor deposition (CVD) processes, used to set gas flows and temperature, save/load process recipes, and start or stop operation.

actions.description: 读取并刷新界面中的工艺参数字段。
actions.description_en: Read and refresh the process parameter fields shown in the interface.

actions.description: 将当前工艺参数和元数据保存为配方文件。
actions.description_en: Save the current process parameters and metadata to a recipe file.

actions.description: 从配方文件打开并载入工艺参数。
actions.description_en: Open a recipe file and load its process parameters.

actions.description: 更新气体流量等运行趋势图。
actions.description_en: Update the run trend plots for gas flow and related variables.

actions.description: 启动配方运行并显示运行状态。
actions.description_en: Start recipe execution and show the running status.

actions.description: 应用当前设定值，如温度和气体参数。
actions.description_en: Apply the current setpoints, such as temperature and gas parameters.
